purpose: Teach: 望遠鏡/アメリカ合衆国/道徳的/発作/教義/先行き/なかつ/陛下

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 天文機器、望遠鏡部品、当社の新製品、進めろ。
lines.en: Astronomical equipment, telescope components—our new product line. Move it forward.
lines.style: Clipped, declarative. Short sharp breaths between phrases. No warmth, all efficiency. Expect compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。アメリカ合衆国、当社の主要市場、引き続き重視します。
lines.en: Yes. The US—our primary market. We'll continue to prioritize it.
lines.style: Steady, measured reply. Slightly formal register. Matching his pace. Affirming without over-explaining.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 企業の道徳的責任、社内、徹底させろ。
lines.en: Corporate ethics and responsibility—embed it thoroughly throughout the organization.
lines.style: Direct, weighty. Each phrase lands with intent. Not harsh, but leaving no room for interpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のメンタル、発作的なストレス、防ぐ取り組み、進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're working on measures to protect our staff's mental health—preventing acute stress episodes.
lines.style: Professional, responsive. Slight emphasis on 'working on' to show active progress. Calm, organized tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 経営の教義、創業者から、引き継ぐべきものだ。
lines.en: Management philosophy—it's something we must carry forward from the founder.
lines.style: Weighted, measured. Slight pause before 'must'—treating this as doctrine, not suggestion. Respectful gravity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の先行き、楽観できない部分も、ございます。
lines.en: Yes. That said, there are parts of the industry outlook that are less than optimistic.
lines.style: Honest, slightly cautious. Gentle downward inflection at the end. Not pessimistic, but realistic.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なかつ市の工場、視察、来週、予定だ。
lines.en: The Nakatsu factory—inspection scheduled for next week.
lines.style: Factual, brief. Minimal elaboration. Stating the plan with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。皇室の方々、陛下のご視察、過去に、いただいたことがあります。
lines.en: Yes. We've actually had visits from the Imperial family in the past—including a visit from His Majesty.
lines.style: Quiet pride, carefully measured. Slight lift in tone on 'Imperial family'—professional respect without boasting.
